facts.claim: Every generated or repaired SQL returns through SafeExecutor.
Gate blocks high-certainty safety and structural failures, while semantic checks belong to Judge.
Judge uses deterministic modes for Gate and database failures, and semantic LLM evaluation only after execution succeeds.
Retry budgets are gate=2, database=2, semantic=5, total SQL attempts=10.
Restricted re-schema is owned by Refiner, limited to one iteration and at most two tables.
No executor produces generated_unverified with success=false.
Current isolated WSL regression run passed 25 tests.
